newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Richina declares 1.0 NZ cps dividend.
newsitem.headline: Richina declares 1.0 NZ cps dividend.

text.p: Richina Pacific Ltd, formerly Mainzeal, on Tuesday declared a one NZ cent per share dividend with a record date of November 29, 1996 (ex dividend December 2) and a pay date of December 12.
A supplementary dividend of 0.176464 would be paid to non-resident shareholders.

The dividend represents a distribution of 35 percent of Richina's NZ$6.6 million profit for the year to June 30, 1996 and is payable on all shares, including those issued in the recent placement and cash issue.
The dividend will be fully imputed.
The company said it would re-introduce a dividend reinvestment plan as many shareholders had expressed a desire to reinvest in the company.
Those shareholders electing to participate will do so at a 7.5 percent discount to the weighted average market price.
A prospectus for the plan is being distributed with the 1996 notice of the AGM and annual report which is being despatched to shareholders today.
The AGM will be held on November 13 at 10.30 a.m.
